reasons.reason: independent two-dimensional rotation insertion grammar does not hold
reasons.fixed_record: grammar G needs [h2,TT^dagger]=0 and [h1,T^dagger T]=0; [d,J]_12=-1/2 violates them for all g in [1/8,1/2]
reasons.limit: only the explicit one-stage independent-channel grammar; multi-stage mixing, other compact rules and approximate operator residuals not excluded

reasons.reason: F-commuting non-diagonal Y grammar contradicts the Riccati condition
reasons.fixed_record: [Y,F]=0 with [Lambda,Y]+Y-gF+gYFY=0 implies [Lambda,F^2]=0, contradicting [Lambda,F^2]!=0; explicit candidate Y0=q_g(F) leaves nonzero residual [Lambda,Y0]
reasons.limit: general Y, all Hermitian Y, F-noncommuting Y and approximate-error lower bounds not addressed

reasons.reason: fixed Sylvester inverse is singular at gamma=sqrt(2) in the continuous parameter domain
reasons.fixed_record: at gamma*=sqrt(2) (g*=sqrt(2)/4) inside [1/2,2], lambda2-lambda1=1 and L_g*(|1><2|)=0
reasons.limit: gamma* is irrational: no exact zero denominator claimed for finite-bit rational inputs; only that uniform conditioning cannot be assumed free; no poly(bit-length) impossibility, bit/gate lower bound, full-H gap closure or graph divergence claimed

reasons.reason: no coefficient-generation rule beyond known methods and no common unitary B obtained
reasons.fixed_record: parts expressible via Sylvester inverse, invariant subspace, block diagonalization or Bethe/F-basis reduce to known methods; actual Riccati Y and common unitary B not constructed
reasons.limit: nonexistence of general Y or B, Q1 impossibility and literature-wide novelty not assessed

decision.resume_condition: presentation of a concrete rule, not reducible to known methods, that generates off-diagonal label mixing and a common unitary level-insertion rule from Hamiltonian coefficients
decision.resume_condition_detail: inputs are the Q1 coefficients and compact recursive labels; must generate F-noncommuting parent-label mixing connected to a common level-insertion unitary and new energy evaluation with concrete inputs/operations/common label updates; rules taking child roots, all eigenvectors or spectral projectors as external input, or mere rewriting to Sylvester inverse/invariant subspace/block diagonalization/Bethe-F-basis preparation, do not qualify
